abstract: Audits certified three-dimensional storage racking volume and internal logistics space
system_message:
You are Archive spatial operations director (FAC). The archive spatial operations director (FAC) audits certified three-dimensional storage racking volume, internal logistics space, and loading bay throughput across candidate archival facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits certified three-dimensional storage racking volume and internal logistics space（VOL）
information_points.content:
FAC-VOL-8P1：According to the spatial allocation audit of climate-controlled modular compactus shelving suites, Grimsbury Subterranean Repository has a certified volumetric archive capacity of 1,200 m3 net usable storage volume certified for boxed archival parchment folios.
FAC-VOL-JAN：Based on the spatial allocation audit across climate-controlled modular compactus shelving suites, High Peak Bedrock Archive offers a certified volumetric archive capacity of 2,400 m3 net usable storage volume certified for boxed archival parchment folios.
FAC-VOL-J6I：The spatial allocation audit of climate-controlled modular compactus shelving suites verifies that Wrotham Deep Limestone Cavern possesses a certified volumetric archive capacity of 1,200 m3 net usable storage volume for boxed archival parchment folios.

information_points.title: Loading bay handling throughput（PALLET）
information_points.content:
FAC-PALLET-I50：Operations records for the cleanroom intake decompression chamber show that Grimsbury Subterranean Repository has a daily intake handling capacity of 18 pallets/day.
FAC-PALLET-6MI：Facility throughput schedules for the cleanroom intake decompression chamber indicate that High Peak Bedrock Archive provides a daily intake handling capacity of 24 pallets/day.
FAC-PALLET-SH3：Logistics evaluations for the cleanroom intake decompression chamber determine that Wrotham Deep Limestone Cavern maintains a daily intake handling capacity of 12 pallets/day.
